commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-panel-qa-v2.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/repo"
cd "$WORK/repo"
EXPECTED="4aadf5fa9c0aa26a221d7a1b8d12ad4082ce4793"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE_SHA|$EXPECTED"
python3 -m venv "$WORK/venv"
set +e
"$WORK/venv/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet pytest pyserial "numpy==2.4.6" > "$WORK/install.log" 2>&1
installed=$?
set -e
echo "PYTEST_NUMPY_INSTALL_EXIT|$installed"
tail -15 "$WORK/install.log"
if test "$installed" -eq 0; then
 echo "PANEL_SUITE_START"
 set +e
 PYTHONPATH=. "$WORK/venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q tests/test_panel.py tests/test_panel_request_security.py tests/test_panel_e2e.py tests/test_panel_fixtures.py tests/test_panel_sync.py tests/test_panel_layout.py tests/test_panel_tokens.py > "$WORK/pytest.log" 2>&1
 tested=$?
 set -e
 echo "PANEL_SUITE_EXIT|$tested"
 tail -100 "$WORK/pytest.log"
else
 echo "PANEL_SUITE|SKIP unavailable isolated test dependencies"
fi
git diff --check 196c305263858fd282ec29774ff56c24c873a33f HEAD
echo "DIFF_CHECK|PASS"
echo "CLEAN|$(test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "PANEL_TESTS_DONE"
